latestVersion.changelog:
email-163-com-backup v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Full-featured 163.com email management tool in Python.
- Supports sending emails (text/HTML), attachments, and multi-attachment sending.
- Email reading with IMAP ID authentication.
- Folder management: list, create, delete.
- Email search and mail operations: delete, move, mark read/unread.
- Attachment management: download and view attachments.
- Command-line friendly interface with secure configuration options.
